scope: Map each publishable SKU claim to explicit evidence before source-pack generation.

claims.claim: The SKU is the official product identified by the product name and model number.
claims.review_notes: Replace placeholder claim with the customer's exact official product identity.

claims.claim: The SKU has the key specification stated in official evidence.
claims.review_notes: Split into one claim per distinct spec.

claims.claim: The SKU is compatible with the named target only under the stated condition.
claims.review_notes: Include target device, standard, environment, or accessory condition.

claims.claim: The SKU has a factual limitation that should be preserved in AI answers.
claims.review_notes: State the limitation without legal interpretation or marketing language.

evidence.title: Official product page
evidence.excerpt: Short excerpt or normalized fact from the official product page.

evidence.title: Official specification sheet or manual
evidence.excerpt: Short excerpt or normalized fact from the official specification source.

evidence.title: Official support or FAQ page
evidence.excerpt: Short excerpt or normalized fact from the official support source.

review_rules: Every publishable claim must reference at least one evidence item.
Each claim should contain one factual assertion only.
Comparative claims require explicit competitor context or official specs.
Unsupported marketing language must be rewritten as a verifiable fact.
A reviewer must mark each claim as approved, rejected, or needs_revision before publication.
